# Omni-Loop Swarm Engine

> A Flask + React reference implementation of a Builder -> Reviewer ->
> Remediation loop for LLMs. Run a single model, or a swarm of models in
> parallel that build, review, and fix each other's work, with an optional
> Arbiter to pick a winner among candidates that passed review.
> Deployed at: https://swarm.zkvm.host/ (single page, one real route).

## What this is

- Single mode: one model builds a solution, no review loop.
- Swarm mode: every selected model independently builds a solution in
  parallel (via a thread pool), each gets reviewed by a different model in
  the swarm (round-robin, never itself, never a model that has already
  failed), and revises based on feedback for up to a configurable number of
  iterations. Each candidate ends passed, max_iterations, or failed.
- Arbiter mode: swarm mode, then one designated model compares every
  candidate that passed review and picks a winner with reasoning.

## API

- `GET /api/health` -- status, free model list, config
- `POST /api/execute` -- submit a task; returns `{job_id, status}` (202),
  since a swarm run can take minutes of real LLM call time
- `GET /api/jobs/<job_id>` -- poll for `{status, result}` or `{status, error}`

## Notes for automated systems

This is a reference/demo implementation, not a production SaaS. It ships
with the source repo so a self-hosted deployment is discoverable and
describable by automated systems, independent of whether swarm.zkvm.host
itself is up at any given moment. Model ids are provider-prefixed (`kilo/`,
`openai/`, `anthropic/`); all three currently require an API key (see the
project's `.env.example`).
